Subject: Billing details & PO routing update

Hi Sean,

Quick note from Alpine Finance — we completed a banking migration and need Redwood to update our remit details so future POs/invoices route to the new account. I've attached the bank update PDF and a new W-9.

Summary: 
- New remit-to bank: Wells Fargo (ending 4321)
- Effective for invoices dated 2026-06-01 and after
- Primary AP contact: Elena Torres, elorres@alpine-industries.com / +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Alpine_Bank_Update.pdf (pdf), W-9_Alpine.pdf (pdf), voided_check_alpine.jpg (image)

We also included a short note on PO preferences: please send POs to procurement@alpine-industries.com; invoices to finance@alpine-industries.com. Let me know if you need a signed letter or additional validation from our bank.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Director of Finance
Alpine Industries

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:12:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing details & PO routing update

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Looping in Marissa (procurement) and Karthik (payments) so they can update the vendor record and confirm any internal PO routing changes.

Quick asks from our side to move this forward: 
1) Please confirm whether the bank change affects ACH only or wire payments as well.
2) If you have a bank letter on company letterhead, that will help speed validation.
3) Can you confirm the named legal entity (exactly as it appears on W-9) for our ERP profile?

Marissa/Karthik — can you advise the usual processing time and whether we need a vendor record re-onboard (or just a supplemental update)? If there's a ticket we should open in ERP, please create it and paste the link.

Sean
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(415) 987-2200

Thanks — I have the attachments and started the vendor update. Notes from procurement: 

- We will not re-onboard; this is a supplemental remit update. I created ticket SVC-4920 in our ERP for audit tracking and payment-team handoff (link: https://erp.redwood.com/tickets/SVC-4920).
- Documents required (we have W-9 + voided check): bank letter would be nice but not required for ACH updates; we will flag for a bank call if anything looks inconsistent.
- PO behavior: POs will still route to the same purchase contact, but invoices will be processed to the new remit-to after the change date. We will add procurement@alpine-industries.com to the PO cc list per their preference.
- Expected timeline: internal validation 2 business days, then payments will accept the new remit details for invoices posted after 2026-06-15. If Treasury needs additional verification for wire transfers it may add 1-2 business days.

Next steps (action owners):
- Marissa: finalize ERP supplemental update and attach files to SVC-4920 (in progress).
- Karthik: confirm with payments team when the change is live for ACH and wires.
- Elena: share bank letter only if available.

Attachment stubs: Alpine_Bank_Update.pdf, W-9_Alpine.pdf, voided_check_alpine.jpg

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
